grade-hint: Exposure, saturation and a light sharpen over the finished picture.
exposure-hint: Brighter or darker, in stops. Changes at once.
saturation-hint: 1 leaves the colours as they are.
quality-hint: Fine adds a light sharpen. A define: the shaders are built again.
haze-hint: Far terrain fades towards the sky's colour.
haze-strength-hint: How much the far terrain fades.
